These are authentic excerpts from STEPBible-Data revision
`b99716b0cddb648ddb95cc786a197180f2f97d48`, licensed CC BY 4.0.
Creator: STEPBible.org, based on work at Tyndale House Cambridge.

`provenance.json` records exact upstream files, original line numbers, fixture
line numbers and SHA-256 hashes. Header notices and selected records are copied
verbatim; rows from separate files are concatenated into small fixtures, using LF
line endings. The upstream source notices remain in each fixture. Source and
license: https://github.com/STEPBible/STEPBible-Data and
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.

`tagnt.txt` includes seven source verses: Matthew 1:1; Mark 1:13, 7:30, 16:8;
Acts 4:25, 24:12; Revelation 2:3. It exercises Greek Unicode, source N selection,
edition displacement annotations, a shorter alternate Mark ending, multiple
lexical analyses, extended lexical suffixes and five-digit lexical identifiers.

`tahot.txt` includes ten source verses: Genesis 1:1, 4:8, 8:17, 14:17, 30:11;
Exodus 4:2; Joshua 21:36; Judges 16:25; Psalm 3:0; Daniel 2:4. It exercises
Hebrew/Aramaic, source segmentation and punctuation, the documented Kedorlaomer
exception, qere replacement and omission, restored R text, excluded X additions,
and Psalm superscriptions.

Deliberately malformed and combined/subdivided-label test records are constructed
in `test/importers_test.dart` and explicitly described there as synthetic.
These fixtures are excerpts and do not establish complete chapter coverage.
